column8: Come sit in the shade, child. The sun is sharp.

Take this banana to your mother on your way.
The boat leans if you stand up. Stay low.
I kept your favorite bowl. Eat before it cools.
You grew taller than the doorway mark.
Wake your sister. The monks will pass soon.
If the fever stays, we go to the clinic at dawn.
I waited under the tamarind tree. I was afraid you wouldn't come.
I came as soon as the shop closed. Did you wait long?
Your voice sounds tired. Did you eat today?
The boat is quiet. Sit next to me, not across.
You always pretend you don't want the sweet one.

Dance with me before the slow songs start.

Do you want the window seat or the one by the fan?

Count the sacks twice. Write the number on the clipboard.
